setup-worktree: bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; echo "[worktree] node=$(node -v 2>/dev/null || echo missing) npm=$(npm -v 2>/dev/null || echo missing) bun=$(bun -v 2>/dev/null || echo missing)"; test -f .nvmrc && echo "[worktree] .nvmrc=$(cat .nvmrc)"'

bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if [ -f config/dev-secrets-config.env.example ] && [ ! -f config/dev-secrets-config.env ]; then cp config/dev-secrets-config.env.example config/dev-secrets-config.env; echo "[worktree] scaffolded config/dev-secrets-config.env from example (no secrets)"; fi'

bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; command -v bun >/dev/null 2>&1 || { echo "[worktree] ERROR: bun is required" >&2; exit 1; }; echo "[worktree] installing with bun (frozen lockfile)"; bun install --frozen-lockfile'

bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; if [ -x backend/edge-worker/node_modules/.bin/wrangler ]; then echo "[worktree] generating wrangler types (local)"; (cd backend/edge-worker && ./node_modules/.bin/wrangler types); elif command -v wrangler >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "[worktree] generating wrangler types (global)"; (cd backend/edge-worker && wrangler types); else echo "[worktree] wrangler not available; skipping type generation"; fi'

bash -lc 'set -euo pipefail; echo "[worktree] typechecking shared"; (cd shared && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit); echo "[worktree] typechecking frontend"; (cd frontend && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit); echo "[worktree] typechecking backend/edge-worker"; (cd backend/edge-worker && bunx tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit)'
